## Product Description 

 The LG LW6024RSMX is a 6,000 BTU smart window air conditioner designed to cool spaces up to 250 square feet efficiently. With built-in Wi-Fi, it allows you to control the unit remotely using the LG ThinQ app on your smartphone. It is also compatible with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, providing hands-free convenience for adjusting temperature settings and fan speeds. This air conditioner offers two cooling and fan speeds, giving you control over your comfort level. The 24-hour digital on/off timer lets you schedule cooling according to your routine, ensuring energy efficiency. Its auto-restart function is a helpful feature, as it restores your previous settings automatically after a power outage. The user-friendly LED display and simple selection control panel make operation effortless, while the included remote control adds extra convenience. Maintenance is easy, thanks to the washable and reusable air filter, which helps maintain clean air. Additionally, the unit features a filter alarm that notifies you when it’s time for cleaning. Compact yet powerful, the LG LW6024RSMX measures approximately 17.3 inches in width, 11.1 inches in height, and 12.8 inches in depth, weighing around 37 pounds.
